name: search_memory
description: Default scope=all, including global decisions. NEVER infer scope=project from task/workspace names; only an explicit USER request permits project-only filtering. If an inferred filter misses, follow retry_without_project_filter before assuming memory is absent. Respect explicit user restrictions. Use one focused topic for related missing decisions; reuse every returned fact it answers. Repeat only for unanswered questions or new conflicts; keyword variants are not independent verification. Check current applicability against sources. Returns titles and whole statements. Follow continuation for more results; detail=full opens an indexed long fact. Empty query browses natural modules. Exact conversation evidence: search_raw.

project_name.description: Optional context, not a filter with all. Required for explicit project-only scope; global decisions may otherwise be missed.

query.description: The specific topic or missing decision to recover; avoid concatenating unrelated task keywords.

budget_tokens.description: Complete-page size: cl100k_base or conservative UTF-8 bytes. Default: cost_budget.search_tokens.

cursor.description: Position from the returned continuation call.

detail.description: auto: whole facts fitting the page; full: one complete fact, even beyond the page size.

scope.description: all for ordinary tasks; project excludes global/other labels and requires explicit user restriction.
